summary: Real-time planning poker in a shared link, no account.
what: Planning poker for estimating user stories together. Open the link, pick a name and an avatar, vote, and the host flips every card at once. Then the highest and lowest votes explain themselves, and the table votes again or moves on.
who: A team estimating together, round a table or on a call, with nobody signing up for anything.

facts.label: Runs in
facts.value: Any browser, installable as a PWA

facts.label: Account
facts.value: None: a shared link or a six-letter code

facts.label: Data
facts.value: Room state on Cloudflare, no database

flow.label: Room server
flow.note: a PartyServer Durable Object on Cloudflare Workers

flow.label: Authoritative room state
flow.note: broadcast to every connection on each change

flowNote: Hosting is a capability, not a page: creating a room stores a secret in the browser, and whoever presents it gets the host controls.
decisions: A PartyServer room on Cloudflare Workers keeps every participant's vote in sync over WebSockets, one Durable Object per room.
The deck and the host's identity persist in Durable Object storage, so a room survives refreshes and reconnects without a database.
No accounts, by design: a shared link is the whole onboarding.
Installable as a PWA, for a phone in a stand-up.
